hints.text: Dividing makes the number smaller, so the decimal point slides to the **left**.
$1{,}000$ has three zeros, so move the point three places left from $4500.$

explanation: $1{,}000 = 10^3$, so dividing by it shifts the decimal point three places to the left.
Start at $4500.$ — one shift gives $450$, two gives $45$, three gives $4.5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check by multiplying back
steps: $4.5 \times 1{,}000$ shifts the point three places right.
